detector.feature_1: phase-oriented standardized conditional residual (Y1-c1 minus healthy conditional mean), sign chosen by sign(lambda*zeta0-c1)
detector.single_episode_score: feature_1 + feature_2 with fixed equal unit weights; health conditional centering and scaling
detector.conditioning: gamma0=1, gamma1=1, known zeta0, model and quantized center
detector.threshold: independent healthy calibration, empirical 99th percentile; strict greater-than alarm
detector.window_scores: non-overlapping 32- and 128-independent-episode sums of audited scores divided by sqrt(block size), one-sided threshold from healthy blocks

full_auth_baseline: protect both target and next transmitted payloads; ideal integrity, no attack enters estimator
sample_unit: one independent two-time physical episode, not individual time points or paired branches
